# Correctness verdict: BLOCK

PR #207 at `49c151a5d3bcb1e6725e61a257cf0895b9752c58`, answering `01a1bf06-ce7e-7bb2-afad-b752711a5248`. One normal-use correctness/cost finding under C34.

**F001: unknown cache state is admitted as cold.** The new path tests only `is_known_warm` (`crates/daemon/src/http/revive.rs:285-287`). That helper returns false on a missing transcript, unknown last-call/TTL, failed read or three-second timeout (`http/cold_wake.rs:85-104`, `crates/core/src/cold_wake.rs:247-256`). All therefore permit the expensive relaunch/compact, including a warm large seat whose read merely timed out. This violates cold-only eligibility. The PM confirmed unknown must refuse.

**Fix:** require positive known-cold evidence before any write; otherwise return `E-RS-REVIVE-CHEAP` with the reason. Keep the known-warm refusal. Cover the unknown/error/timeout branches with focused refusal/no-write tests.

The other rules hold: Claude-only, fixed Sonnet 5.5, explicit invocation only, and launch-model flags rather than `/model`. The ordinary compact control follows successful registration/model wait. The regression checks Sonnet launch arguments and recorded model, using fake registration; it is not live Claude model acceptance. Existing stopped-seat requirements and compact-half failure are documented.

Exact-head CI `42573687553`, artifact `13654387342`: **2,342 Rust passes**, six separately skipped; all three new cheap-compaction cases executed, but none covers F001. CI tested merge `cea38247a11bcb0ac4a9231230ffdadc84d5ecc2` with current main. `pr-freeze` FINAL/CLEAN; review HEAD stayed fixed. No local builds/tests, product edits or lifecycle operations; optional mutants were not required.
